Last updated: July 11, 2025

At Tat Sat Universe, your privacy matters as much as your energy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you engage with us through www.tatsatuniverse.com (the “Site”), whether you’re exploring our offerings, placing an order, or simply walking the path with us online.

When we say “we,” “our,” or “us,” we’re referring to Tat Sat Universe, and “you” refers to you — the seeker, the visitor, the soul we’re here to serve.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as needed - to reflect evolving technology, legal requirements, or our deepening practices. Any updates will be posted here, with a revised “Last Updated” date.

What Information We Collect

1. Information You Provide

When you place an order, sign up for emails, or reach out for support, you may provide:

  • Name, address, email, phone number
  • Shipping and billing information
  • Account login details (if applicable)
  • Any personal messages you choose to share
2. Automatically Collected Data

Through cookies and similar tools, we collect information like:

  • Device and browser type
  • IP address and general location
  • Site usage patterns and click behavior

This helps us improve your browsing experience and personalize what you see.

3. Information from Third Parties

We may also receive information from:

  • Platforms like Shopify (used to power our store)
  • Payment gateways and shipping providers
  • Advertising or analytics partners (if you’ve consented)

How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information to:

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Send shipping updates or confirmations
  • Respond to inquiries and provide customer support
  • Improve our offerings and optimize your user experience
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Protect against fraudulent or malicious activity
  • Occasionally share healing insights or offers - only if you’ve opted in

Note: 

We never sell your personal information. We only share it with trusted partners who help us serve you better.

Cookies & Tracking Tools

We use cookies to:

  • Keep your session active
  • Personalize your experience
  • Measure performance

You can manage cookies via your browser settings. We also honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals, allowing you to opt out of tracking where applicable.

Learn more about Shopify’s cookie practices here: https://www.shopify.com/legal/cookies

Data & Children

Our services are not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe we have, please email us for immediate removal.

Data Sharing

We may share your personal data with:

  • Shopify and integrated platforms that run our store
  • Payment and logistics providers
  • Customer support platforms
  • Legal or regulatory bodies if required

We never disclose sensitive personal information without your consent.

For International Users

Your data may be processed outside your country. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, following Standard Contractual Clauses and GDPR regulations where applicable.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request corrections or deletions
  • Opt out of marketing communications
  • Limit or object to how your data is processed
  • Lodge a complaint with a data authority if necessary.

You can make these requests by contacting us directly.

Communication Preferences

You can unsubscribe from our emails anytime using the link at the bottom of our messages. We'll still send order confirmations or service messages when necessary.

Security & Retention

We take your privacy seriously. While no system is flawless, we use encryption, secure hosting, and best practices to safeguard your data.

We retain information only as long as needed - for your service, compliance, or legitimate interest. After that, it's respectfully deleted.

Contact Us

For questions, data requests, or soul-aligned support, reach us at:

Email: info@tatsatuniverse.com
Postal Address:

Closing Note

Your trust is sacred. Your information is safe. At Tat Sat Universe, everything begins and ends with truth.

The Ultimate Truth
